newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Saudi man for the shooting death of a compatriot, Saudi state television reported.
It quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying Abdel Rahman bin Mohammad al-Dawsary was executed in the capital Riyadh for killing a fellow Saudi in a dispute.
He was the 27th person executed this year in the conservative kingdom that strictly imposes Islamic sharia law.
Saudi Arabia beheads convicted drug smugglers, rapists, murderers and other criminals.
